set.body: PRD C-9 and X-1 through X-17 remain normative. Reconciled 2026-09-17: typed relations/designs, keyed cap-monotone sampling, directed/undirected edge results, failure-policy reductions, contrasts and RepetitionDesign are implemented. Equality clauses now execute via a typed keyed candidate index in exhaustive, bottom-k and within paths; full relations remain residual filters and source order/diagnostics are preserved. Independent Cartesian comparisons and a killed Cartesian-execution mutant verify semantics and work reduction. Remaining acceptance: surface decomposition and partial association; remaining reference cases; shared resumable within-pair scheduling. Preserve Mass/Intensity/Signed distinctions and descriptive model scope. No alternate workflow hierarchy or cell-wise inference.
